hints.title: Street Connectivity Rules
hints.text: Each street type 1 through 6 connects two specific directions: left, right, up, or down.

hints.title: Mutual Connection Check
hints.text: A move from cell A to neighbor cell B is valid only if cell A opens toward cell B and cell B opens back toward cell A.

hints.title: Reachability Traversal
hints.text: Start from (0, 0) and traverse connected cells. Return true if (m - 1, n - 1) is reached, false otherwise.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Ignoring whether the neighboring cell has a reciprocal opening leads to invalid road traversal.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tracking visited cells prevents infinite loops and guarantees linear O(R * C) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate models port directions accurately and checks that adjacent cells reciprocally connect.
complexity.notes: Top-left starts at (0, 0) and destination is (m - 1, n - 1).
